From: Ellie Summers <ellie@brightcare.io>

Cc: 
Date: 2027-02-10T16:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro call follow-up — Redwood fit for BrightCare

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning — really helpful to hear how Redwood approaches cost controls and predictable inference for production. A couple of quick notes from our side:

- Primary goals: reduce inference spend on embeddings/reranking by 30% while keeping P99 latency under 250ms for interactive workflows.
- Key constraints: must run in our VPC (HIPAA) for PHI, and we need model pinning/versioning for audits.

We'd like to set up a technical deep-dive (your serving/runtime engineers + our platform/infra lead) to cover architecture, network topology, and an early perf/latency profile. Would next week work?

Suggested attendees from BrightCare: myself (product), Raj Patel (platform/CTO), and one of our infra engineers (TBD).

Appreciate a couple slot options and a calendar invite if that helps.

Cheers,
Ellie Summers
Head of Product, BrightCare Health
ellie@brightcare.io
